services.name: Property Rentals
services.desc: Historic Beverly offers the the 1781 John Cabot House, and lawn of our c. 1694 John Hale House (“Hale Farm”) located at 39 Hale Street in Beverly, Massachusetts for private events. The John Cabot House is a Georgian-style mansion built in 1781 during the Revolutionary War; it was the first brick mansion built in Beverly. The wealth of the Cabot family is reflected in the architecture of the house, the beautifully carved paneling, and decorations such as the Dutch tiles surrounding the parlor fireplace. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Historic Beverly is proud to offer several school programs that offer exciting and engaging educational opportunities for students. All programs can be adapted for older or younger students and can be brought into the classroom or done at one of our three historic properties. All programs incorporate the updated Massachusetts Curriculum Framework standards. We are happy to work with teachers to create custom programs or add unique elements to classroom presentations. Fees: In-class programs are available for $150/class. If three or more in-class programs are booked for the same day, the cost is $125/class. blurb: John Cabot (1744-1821), son of Joseph and Elizabeth Cabot, was born in Salem, part of large family of 11 children. His father and grandfather were successful merchants. John attended Harvard College, graduating in 1763. Following his father’s death, John’s mother moved to Beverly with her children in 1768.
